stem: A lifecycle schedule must respect two minimum storage durations before objects can move out of a class: Glacier Flexible Retrieval and S3 Glacier Deep Archive. Select TWO minimum-duration values correctly matched to their class. (Select TWO.)
rationale: Glacier Flexible Retrieval carries a 90-day minimum storage duration before an object can be deleted, overwritten, or transitioned out without an early charge. Glacier Deep Archive's minimum storage duration is 180 days, the longest of the classes covered in this lesson. The 30-day figure belongs to the IA classes, not Glacier Flexible Retrieval. The 90-day figure belongs to Glacier Instant and Flexible Retrieval, not Glacier Deep Archive. S3 Standard-IA's minimum storage duration is 30 days, not 90 days.
